name: Dimension Rift : Otaku Save The World
source:
When "Edith," the mystical pen capable of rewriting the storylines of anime worlds, is stolen, the real world faces turmoil as dimensional rifts tear open, allowing anime characters to spill into reality.

"Shimada Yuki," the story's protagonist—a legendary-class otaku—must team up with "Lecia," the guardian of anime world balance, to stop this chaos. However, capturing the escaped characters proves far from simple, as they must deal with countless mishaps and the quirky, troublesome personalities of these characters that give Yuki such headaches he's forced to seek help from "Shirogane Hime," a beautiful IT genius who excels at everything—especially her sharp tongue.

What's worse is that the only way to send these displaced characters back to their worlds is to "capture their hearts." Will Yuki and his companions be able to win over all the characters' hearts and protect both worlds? Or will everything be rewritten... by the pen Edith?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3930590/Dimension_Rift__Otaku_Save_The_World]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当能够改写动漫世界故事情节的神秘之笔“伊迪丝”被盗后，现实世界面临着混乱，次元裂缝撕裂，动漫角色进入现实。

故事的主角“岛田由纪”是一位传奇级御宅族，他必须与动漫世界平衡的守护者“莱西亚”联手，阻止这场混乱。然而，捕获逃跑的角色绝非易事，因为他们必须应对无数的不幸事件，以及这些角色古怪、麻烦的性格，这让由纪头疼不已，他被迫向“白银姬”寻求帮助，她是一位美丽的IT天才，样样都擅长，尤其是她那尖利的舌头。

更糟糕的是，将这些流离失所的角色送回他们的世界的唯一方法就是“俘获他们的心”。由希和他的伙伴们能否赢得所有角色的心并保护两个世界呢？还是一切都将被伊迪丝之笔重写？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3930590/Dimension_Rift__Otaku_Save_The_World]Steam[/url]]
